derivation:
by
  change Set.range (Subtype.val ∘ I.subschemeι.base) ⊆ (Z₀ : Set V)
  simpa only [Subtype.range_val] using Set.range_comp_subset_range I.subschemeι.base (Subtype.val : (Z₀ : Set V) → V)
explanation: The outer subscheme inclusion is definitionally the subtype inclusion of Z₀. Thus the result specializes containment of a composite's range in the outer function's range. The current proof establishes this containment manually.
